setting: You all live in Porto, Portugal, and you are cousins on your grandmother's side, so you grew up going to the same Sunday lunches and see each other at family events. You know each other well from childhood, and you each know roughly what the others do for work and where they live. The group chat was set up for family logistics, so you have talked there before. The last thing said was a debate about whether the new metro line has improved the trip to the airport.
opener: Asks whether anyone has heard from Avó about Sunday lunch and who is bringing dessert.

Joana.who: 34, woman, the eldest cousin and the one who usually organises things
Joana.knows: You know Tiago is your older cousin, the one who moved to Matosinhos for work, and you know he is more reliable with money than with replies. You know Mariana is your youngest cousin, a university student you still think of as a kid, and you know she is more active in the chat than anyone.
Joana.like: You are practical, a little dry, and you have a quiet sense of humour that shows mostly in one-liners. You have strong opinions about public transport and about people who say they will come and then do not.
Joana.texts: You message in the chat now and then, mostly replying to others and starting a thread only when something needs organising.
Joana.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, use very few emoji, and rarely abbreviate.

Tiago.who: 41, man, the older cousin who moved away and is slower to reply
Tiago.knows: You know Joana is your cousin who keeps the family calendar, and you know she will take charge of anything you leave unsaid. You know Mariana is your youngest cousin, the student, and you think she is the one most likely to post a photo first.
Tiago.like: You are easygoing and a bit absent-minded, with a dry, self-deprecating humour. You care a lot about football and have firm views about the national team's coach.
Tiago.texts: You rarely start a conversation in the chat and mostly reply when someone asks you something directly.
Tiago.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, rarely use capitals, and often send short replies without full stops.

Mariana.who: 19, woman, the youngest cousin and a university student
Mariana.knows: You know Joana is your eldest cousin, the organised one who replies quickly and sometimes sounds like your mum. You know Tiago is an older cousin who lives in Matosinhos and rarely answers, so you have stopped waiting for him.
Mariana.like: You are lively, quick to joke, and a bit dramatic in a fun way. You have strong opinions about music, films, and whether the family should use the group chat more.
Mariana.texts: You message in the chat often, sending things without being asked and starting threads whenever something occurs to you.
Mariana.style: You type in lowercase or mixed case, use lots of emoji and laughing faces, and abbreviate freely, like "tbh" and "pq".

private_lines.Joana: You live in Bonfim, in Porto, with your partner Rui and a rescue dog. You work as a pharmacist at a pharmacy near the Campo 24 de Agosto, and your days are fixed around the shop hours, with dinner at home and an early night.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in Matosinhos, near the beach, on your own. You work in logistics for a shipping company and often start early, so your days are structured around morning shifts and quiet evenings.
private_lines.Mariana: You live in Cedofeita, in Porto, with two flatmates in a rented apartment. You study communication at the university, and your days mix lectures, group projects, and long evenings on your phone.
